context: Recording a profile on the phone over the network fails with 'Timed out waiting for device to boot' even when the phone shows as available. A recording 5 minutes later passed. The wait-until-available design was withdrawn, because 'available' is not a ready signal. A cable was never tried.

options.gain: Five minutes of measurement may remove the problem entirely.
options.how: Plug the phone into the Mac; a Mac session records a few profiles in a row and reports.
options.label: Try a cable first
options.lose: Needs you to plug in the phone.

options.how: ios-ship's profile job retries once after a wait (about 5 minutes) when it sees that error.
options.label: Retry on the known failure
options.lose: A slow profile; the cause stays unknown.

ref: c48 (phone profiling waits until the phone is free)
title: Choose the next design for phone profiling
why: The cheapest measurement first; if the cable works, nothing needs building.
